links.outcome: Detection of clinically important drug-drug interactions by LLMs
links.effect: All four LLMs recognized warfarin interactions but missed the metoprolol-verapamil interaction; major patient-safety impact was noted for drug interaction identification.
links.quote: In terms of potential drug-drug interactions, all LLMs recognized interactions with warfarin but missed the interaction between metoprolol and verapamil.

links.outcome: LLM identification of dosage regimen errors
links.effect: ChatGPT performed well overall on dosage regimen errors except for the simvastatin query; impacts of dosing errors were categorized as minor.
links.quote: For identification of dosage regimen errors, ChatGPT performed well overall, except for the query related to simvastatin.

screen.reason: Evaluated the baseline capabilities and safety impacts of four LLMs on simulated medication review and reconciliation tasks using predefined clinical vignettes/prompts.
